data.cultural_impact: The name "Dharani" is deeply rooted in Indian culture, representing earth as a source of stability, fertility, and growth. It is revered in Hinduism as a symbol of the ground beneath our feet that provides us with a solid base in life. In various rituals and practices, Dharani is invoked to bring about prosperity, longevity, and protection.

Dharani is believed to be the source of nourishment, sustenance, and strength, providing deep spiritual renewal and grounding energy. By invoking the name Dharani, one can tap into this fundamental force of life, finding inner peace, protection, and serenity.
